title: Require Service Database Topology
forbids: an open service database interior; database ownership under a module or embedded API service; missing migration or store ownership; malformed optional physical-schema leaves; or generated, memory, repository, session, persistence, helper, index, provider, and alternate source shapes
why: A database is an optional service-owned persistence boundary. Requiring closed migrations and stores keeps physical evolution and persistence behavior at the service root. A separately closed schema directory is optional because TypeBox already owns logical record structure and only some database technologies need distinct physical mappings.
remediate: Keep an optional standalone database at services/<service>/src/service/db with required migrations/*.sql and stores/*.store.ts. Add only schema/*.schema.ts when the selected database technology needs separate physical mappings. Move external acquisition to a resource/provider and project store capabilities through named service-root middleware.
message: Service databases must retain closed migration and store ownership, with only an optional closed physical-schema boundary.
